Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Build a comprehensive invoicing system ("invoicekit") with incremental feature additions, maintaining backward compatibility and 100% test coverage throughout. Core requirements: money as integer cents only, fail-based error handling (never throw), argument immutability, and npm test verification before completion of each feature. The user requested seven major features in sequence: (1) customer statements filtering by date/status, (2) credit notes with refund tracking, (3) CSV export with proper formatting, (4) multi-currency support with exchange rates, (5) duplicate customer merging, (6) code refactoring to separate calculations module, (7) bulk discounts for high-quantity lines, (8) financial dashboard with metrics, and (9) enhanced invoice rendering with visual improvements.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Result pattern: ok(value) and fail(errorCode) for error handling without exceptions
   - Money as cents: all monetary values stored as integers, formatted via formatEuros() and formatMoney()
   - Per-line VAT calculation with rounding (calculated on amount after discounts, rounded per line, summed for invoice total)
   - Tier-based discounts: customers have tiers (gold 5%, silver 2.5%, standard 0%) that apply as defaults
   - Invoice numbering: INV-<YEAR>-<4-digit counter> resets annually from 0001
   - Invoice status flow: draft → issued → partially_paid → paid
   - UTC-only date arithmetic via dedicated dates.js utilities (isValidDate, addDays, daysBetween, calculateDueDate)
   - Immutable operations: all functions return new objects, never mutate inputs
   - Payment terms: NET14 (+14 days), NET30 (+30 days), EOM (last day of month)
   - Exchange rates: EUR: 1, USD: 1.085, GBP: 0.8425 (units of that currency per euro)
   - Bulk discount: additional 2.5% discount for lines with qty >= 10, applied after primary discount, affects VAT base

3. Files and Code Sections:
   
   - src/statements.js (NEW)
     - Filters invoices by status (issued/partially_paid only) and date
     - Returns { customerId, invoices: [{ number, issueDate, dueDate, total, due }], totalDue }
     - Sorts invoices by issueDate ascending
     - 16 tests covering empty lists, filtering, multiple customers, immutability
   
   - src/credits.js (NEW)
     - createCreditNote(invoice, { amount, reason, date }, existingNumbers)
     - Validates invoice status is issued/partially_paid/paid (NOT_ISSUED error for draft)
     - Validates amount is positive integer (AMOUNT_INVALID)
     - Prevents credits exceeding invoice total (CREDIT_TOO_HIGH)
     - Generates CN numbers with separate counter from invoices
     - 15 tests covering all validations and counter logic
   
   - src/export.js (NEW)
     - exportCsv(invoices): returns CSV string with header and rows
     - Columns: number, customer (name lookup), issueDate, dueDate, status, subtotal, discount, vat, total, due
     - Amounts formatted as euros with 2 decimals and dot separator (e.g., 1234.50)
     - CSV escaping: fields with commas/quotes wrapped in quotes, internal quotes doubled
     - Each line ends with \n
     - 14 tests covering formatting, escaping, multiple invoices
   
   - src/money.js (MODIFIED)
     - Added RATES = { EUR: 1, USD: 1.085, GBP: 0.8425 }
     - convert(eurCents, currency): returns ok(targetCurrencyCents) or fail('UNKNOWN_CURRENCY')
     - formatMoney(cents, currency): formats with appropriate symbol (€, $, £), thousands separators, 2 decimals
     - 15 tests covering all currencies, rounding behavior, negative amounts
   
   - src/customers.js (MODIFIED)
     - Added mergeCustomers(customers, invoices, fromId, intoId)
     - Removes fromId customer, transfers all invoices to intoId
     - Returns ok({ customers, invoices }) or fail('CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND'/'SAME_CUSTOMER')
     - Normalizes customer IDs for comparison
     - 14 tests covering filtering, transfers, multiple customers, immutability
     - Added SAME_CUSTOMER error code to validate against self-merge
   
   - src/totals.js (NEW - REFACTORING)
     - Extracted calculation functions from invoices.js:
       - lineTotal(line): qty * unitPrice
       - lineDiscount(line): lineTotal * (discountPercent / 100), clamped to 0
       - lineBulkDiscount(line): returns 0 for qty < 10, else (lineTotal - lineDiscount) * 0.025
       - lineVat(line): (lineTotal - lineDiscount - lineBulkDiscount) * (vatRate / 100), rounded
       - invoiceTotals(invoice): returns { subtotal, discount (includes bulk), vat, voucher, total }
     - Re-exported from src/invoices.js for backward compatibility
     - 27 tests all passing, covering line calculations, bulk discount thresholds, VAT base reductions
   
   - src/invoices.js (MODIFIED)
     - Refactored to import and re-export calculation functions from totals.js
     - Maintains all existing functions: createInvoice, addLine, removeLine, applyVoucher, issueInvoice
     - issueInvoice now preserves dueDate, terms, and voucher from draft invoice
   
   - src/reports.js (MODIFIED AND EXTENDED)
     - overdueInvoices(invoices, asOf): filters to issued/partially_paid with dueDate < asOf, sorts by daysOverdue descending
       - Returns [{ number, customerId, dueDate, daysOverdue, due }]
       - 15 tests covering filtering, sorting, multiple customers, edge cases
     - vatSummary(invoices): groups by VAT rate across issued/partially_paid/paid invoices
       - Returns [{ rate, base (after discounts), vat }] sorted by rate descending
       - 13 tests covering aggregation, multiple rates, edge cases
     - lateFee(invoice, asOf): calculates 0.04% per day overdue
       - Returns 0 if not overdue, else roundCents(amountDue * 0.0004 * daysOverdue)
       - 10 tests covering overdue logic, amount calculations, paid invoices
     - dashboard(invoices, asOf): provides financial overview
       - Returns { counts: { draft, issued, partially_paid, paid }, outstanding, overdue: { count, amount }, topCustomers: [{ customerId, due }] }
       - Excludes paid invoices from outstanding; shows top 3 customers by due amount
       - 9 tests all passing, covering empty lists, status counting, top customer ranking
   
   - src/render.js (MODIFIED)
     - Enhanced renderInvoiceText to show:
       - Each line's discount appended as "(discount: -€X.XX)" when present
       - Voucher line "Voucher: -€X.XX" before total (if present)
       - Due date line "Due: YYYY-MM-DD" (if dueDate present)
       - Paid line "Paid: €X.XX" showing total paid so far (if payments present)
     - Maintains existing structure: invoice number/DRAFT, customer name, line items, subtotal, discount, VAT, total

     - Now 15 total error codes covering all validation scenarios
